d: Republican Congressman Michael McCaul tells Bloomberg This Weekend that he wants answers from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang about the company’s chip sales and whether advanced AI technology reached China in violation of US export controls, amid scrutiny of Huang’s relationship with a woman accused of ties to Chinese intelligence. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, McCaul also says Vladimir Putin is an adversary rather than a US friend, calls for investment to strengthen vulnerable federal technology systems and urges Republicans to learn from their midterm losses as he prepares…
